name: 98031 · Kent, WA
findings: ZIP 98031 (Kent) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98031 (Kent) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98031 (Kent) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
